title: Collections EMPTY singletons + Empty-family read contract
statement: Collections.EMPTY_SET/EMPTY_LIST/EMPTY_MAP are JVM-clinit-injected non-null immutable singletons; every read succeeds (size=0, isEmpty=true, contains*=false, empty iteration, empty Map views, exhausted next() -> NoSuchElementException, List.get(i) -> IndexOutOfBoundsException). The SGET-MISS null broke dooz DataStore parse (F-154).
